concepts.gloss_en: Minchah — meal-offering / the afternoon (Minchah) prayer; aspect of judgments (dinim)
Menuchah — rest / repose; aspect of prophecy (nevuah)

reason_for_human: These are two different words, not inflections of one. Occ 731 is מִנְחָה (meal-offering / Minchah prayer, glossed as dinim), while occ 3513 is מְנוּחָה/מְנֻחָה (rest, glossed as nevuah) — different roots, different vocalization, and the text even spells the second with a vav (מנוחה). Must split.
